entities.summary: Paul Gorguloff, originally Pavel Timofeyevich Gorgulov, was a Russian émigré who shot and fatally wounded the French president Paul Doumer at a book fair at the Hôtel Salomon de Rothschild in Paris on 6 May 1932.
